note: The single source of truth for delivery pricing. The storefront and the Shopify rate service MUST both read this file. Every amount is in pence. Changing a price means a new version string, never an edit in place.

personalDelivery.label: Personal delivery
personalDelivery.note: Bands are selected on the UNROUNDED return mileage. The first band whose upperMiles covers the distance wins. upperMiles is inclusive.

largerVehicle.label: Larger vehicle charge
largerVehicle.note: Charged once per personal delivery order, not per statue. Never charged on collection orders.

assembly.label: In-home assembly
assembly.note: Only for statues the buyer has ticked for assembly.

boxStorage.label: Original box storage
boxStorage.note: Nothing is due today. The first charge falls one month after the box is collected. Not purchasable at checkout until a subscriptions app is in place.

limits.note: Beyond the last band there is no published price. The quote must fail loudly and route the buyer to a manual quote. It must never fall back to the top band, to zero, or to a guess. 1,400 covers the mainland: the furthest district measured from the dispatch point is Thurso (KW14) at 1,338 return miles. The 1,000-1,400 band is one zone rather than the owner's two because Shopify allows a location only ten delivery zones.

ferry.note: No ferry route may be sold through self-checkout until tariff rules are approved and recorded here. A router's avoid-ferries flag is not proof a route has no ferry crossing: it silently returns a land route that may not exist, or no route at all. Until then these destinations are manual-quote only.
